instructions.name: begin_run
docs: Rollup, the Player. Copies the Seed from the SeedVault into the Player's own (private)
Board and starts the Player's clock: this is the first moment the Player can learn the
piece sequence.

instructions.name: check_seed
docs: Rollup, anyone. Succeeds once the Seed is drawn and reveals nothing: clients poll it to
know when a run can begin, because the SeedVault itself cannot be read.

instructions.name: claim_timeout
docs: Base layer, anyone, after the submission deadline. For a Match whose Boards were never
delegated (nobody played): both Players forfeit, so both entries are refunded. A Board
that is still delegated cannot be claimed here; `seal` + `commit_boards` come first.

instructions.name: commit_boards
docs: Rollup, anyone. Closes the permissions and commits + undelegates the sealed Boards to the
base layer, where their contents become public, and the emptied SeedVault with them.

instructions.name: delegate_joiner
docs: Base layer, anyone. Delegates the joiner's Board to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: delegate_opener
docs: Base layer, anyone. Delegates the opener's Board and the SeedVault to the TEE validator
(pass its identity).

instructions.name: finish
docs: Rollup, the Player. Ends the run early; the score is what has been replayed.

instructions.name: init_permission
docs: Rollup, anyone. Creates the Board's permission: private, readable only by its Player.

instructions.name: init_vault_permission
docs: Rollup, anyone. Creates the SeedVault's permission: private with no member at all, so
nobody can read the Seed from outside the program.

instructions.name: join_session
docs: Base layer, anyone, right after `tesoro_core::join_match`. Creates the joiner's Board,
sets their submission deadline and asks `tesoro_core` to push the Match's refund deadline
out past it.

instructions.name: open_session
docs: Base layer, anyone, right after `tesoro_core::open_match`. Binds a Session, the opener's
Board and a SeedVault to the still-Open Match. The opener may play before anybody joins.

instructions.name: play
docs: Rollup, the Player. Replays `moves` on the Board with the engine. An illegal move
rejects the whole transaction. The run ends when the engine reports game over.

instructions.name: request_seed
docs: Rollup, anyone. Requests VRF randomness from the delegated oracle queue; the oracle calls
back into `seed_callback` inside the rollup, which writes it only into the SeedVault. May
be repeated until the output arrives.

instructions.name: seal
docs: Rollup, anyone. Marks both Boards final: allowed only when both runs are closed
(finished, game over, or their window elapsed) or their deadlines passed, so nobody's
moves are exposed while the other Player can still play. Needs both Boards in the rollup,
so it cannot happen before a second Player has joined. The permissionless timeout: a
Player who never began simply forfeits.

instructions.name: seed_callback
docs: Rollup, called by the VRF program only. Stores the Seed in the private SeedVault.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Base layer, anyone. Settles the Pot through `tesoro_core` from the committed Boards.
`remaining_accounts` are the payout accounts as for `tesoro_core::settle_match`.

errors.name: InvalidMatch
errors.msg: match is not a Block Puzzle match in the right state

errors.name: NotThePlayer
errors.msg: signer is not this board's player

errors.name: PermissionNotReady
errors.msg: board permission is not set up

errors.name: NotSealable
errors.msg: board is not ready to seal yet

errors.name: AlreadyJoined
errors.msg: a second Player already joined this session

errors.name: NotJoined
errors.msg: no second Player has joined this session

types.name: Account
docs: One Account's identity ledger. Balances mirror the sum of its Holdings, split by whether the
Gemas are own-sourced (Source owned by this Account) or won (any other Source).

fields.name: own_reserved
docs: Reserved for Offers (part of the totals, not free to enter Matches or redeem).

types.name: Board
docs: One Player's run. Private in the rollup; public once committed after both runs close. The
Seed is zero until the Player calls `begin_run`.

fields.name: log
docs: Packed moves: `piece | x << 16 | y << 24`. Lets anyone re-verify the score.

types.name: Line
docs: A slice of Gemas of one Source moving into a Pot or a reservation.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned / no-show.

types.name: SeedVault
docs: Holds the Seed for a Match inside the rollup. Delegated with a private permission that has no
member, so no wallet can read it; only `begin_run` moves it, into the beginning Player's own
Board. Wiped before it is committed back.

fields.name: players
docs: Wallets of the seats: 0 opened the `tesoro_core` Match, 1 joined (default until then).

fields.name: opener_deadline
docs: The Match's Queue window at open: the opener must begin before it or forfeits.

fields.name: deadline
docs: From the join: Players who have not begun by then forfeit. Zero until a Player joins.

fields.name: result
docs: 0 = opener wins, 1 = joiner wins, 2 = draw.

fields.name: seed
docs: Copied from the committed Boards at settlement (public by then); zero before.

fields.name: result
docs: 0 = opener wins, 1 = joiner wins, 2 = draw.

types.name: Side
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).
